confidence: Low. Many concrete motives are established, but no named person is tied to opened poison or the fatal glass.
plausibility_notes: Artie accepting another job usefully complicates the obvious resignation motive.
Hugh and Monet face potentially severe exposure; their stakes presently exceed several artistic grievances.
Every character confessing both an error and donor coercion feels patterned and engineered, although it fits a structured party round.
Brie sounds more comic than several confessions, but that difference does not itself justify suspicion.
No confession resolves means or timeline; motives should not substitute for those.
